brand.name: Dragons Hire
brand.tagline: The right dragon for the right mission.

hero.title: The right dragon for the right mission.
hero.subtitle: Describe the cargo, the route and the risk. We compare speed, range, temperament and availability — then you choose.

price.title: Price locked on the spot
price.description: Calculated server-side from risk, distance and load. No surprise at checkout.

hold.title: A booking that holds the dragon
hold.description: Fifteen minutes to confirm. After that the dragon returns to the fleet.

score.title: Recommendations with reasons
score.description: Every dragon comes with why it is there — and what it actually costs.

howItWorks.title: Three steps to takeoff
howItWorks.subtitle: No spreadsheets, no phone calls, no wrong dragon.

describe.title: Describe the mission
describe.description: Cargo, passengers, distance and risk level. The form takes two minutes.

match.title: Get the ranking
match.description: Every available dragon is scored and justified, so you know why it fits.

book.title: Book and fly
book.description: Price locked on the spot. The booking holds the dragon for 15 minutes while you confirm.

featured.title: Featured fleet
featured.subtitle: Each sheet shows what matters: load, range, temperament and hourly rate.
featured.empty: The fleet could not be loaded right now.

credits.title: Art credits
credits.subtitle: All fleet artwork comes from the Wikimedia Commons public API. The acquisition pipeline queries the API, verifies the license, downloads the image, crops and recompresses it — then records this metadata.
credits.note: Every work is in the public domain. Metadata resolved through the Commons API and cached in src/content/art-credits.json.

footer.note: No dragon was harmed while building this website.

account.hint: Accounts arrive in the next phase. Meanwhile, browse the fleet and the art credits.
